Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You stop where the prints grow hurried and look ahead with a new understanding.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Time
Ten minutes per attempt.
Target / range / shape
An accessible trail; 10 minutes
Duration
Information and earned progress persist for the stated task; completed changes remain until circumstances alter them.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill

Before rolling, agree with the DA on what you are trying to accomplish and what is at risk. The DA states how much progress completes the task and whether progress carries over between attempts. Add the progress shown by your result. If the action has no uncertain consequence, resolve it without a roll.

Weak
1 progress toward finding the trail’s destination; identify one supported sign of the travelers’ recent pace.
Standard
2 progress, the pace information above, and one supported warning sign.
Strong
3 progress, both findings above, and a usable route around one known hazard, if one exists.

Source: design/cards/read-a-dangerous-trail.md at bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809.
